executive.headline: Reachable to AI today.
executive.summary: The AI crawlers used to read the web fetch the full page directly. Legibility and obstacles measured on the service page.

pillars.name: Reachability
pillars.q: Can AI systems reach the service?

checks.name: Reachable by AI retrievers
checks.result: The AI crawlers used to read the web fetch the full page directly.
checks.fix: Keep public service paths open to legitimate AI retrieval agents.

pillars.name: Legibility
pillars.q: Can AI read and understand it?

checks.name: Structured data
checks.result: No structured data for AI to extract facts from.
checks.fix: Add service schema (GovernmentService / HowTo) so eligibility, steps and fees are machine-readable.

checks.name: Shows when it was updated
checks.result: No 'last updated' date, so AI can't tell if it's current.
checks.fix: Expose a machine-readable last-updated date (dateModified or a Last-Modified header).

checks.name: Guidance in the page, not a PDF
checks.result: Guidance is on the page itself, not locked in PDFs.

checks.name: Answer-friendly layout
checks.result: Some structure, but key facts are mostly in prose.
checks.fix: Put eligibility, documents, steps and fees in short lists or tables.

observations.name: Language coverage
observations.detail: Declares its language ('pt-br') but offers no other-language version.

pillars.name: Obstacles to AI readers
pillars.q: What does the scan observe about the page constructions tested in the study?

checks.name: Rendered extraction contains more words than served HTML
checks.result: Within the recorded the main content extraction scopes, the rendered/served word addition share is 12% (34 added; 255 matching), below this candidate check's threshold.

checks.name: Text in the assessed region is hidden by a recorded mechanism
checks.result: The assessed region contains 113 document words hidden by the recorded mechanisms — opacity:0 (89 words), offscreen (24 words); 176 words are visible. Accessibility-tree exclusion is recorded separately (0 words). This census does not establish that the hidden text is service guidance.
